newsitem.title: CHINA: Chiwan Wharf plans rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Chiwan Wharf plans rights issue.

text.p: China's Chiwan Wharf Holdings Ltd, based in the southern city of Shenzhen, on Thursday said it planned to make a two-for-10 rights issue in the near future.

The offer, tentatively priced at between 4.5 and six yuan per rights share, has been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the nation's top securities authority, the firm said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times newspaper.
Chiwan, which manages port facilities, said it would release further details on the offer in a forthcoming rights prospectus.
